units.source: In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__, it's possible to select multiple notes at one time. This won't affect the currently displayed note, but it allows to do batch operations.

units.context: Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection
Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection > Selecting notes one by one

units.source: To individually select each note, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_1__ key and click on the note to be selected.
units.context: Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection > Selecting notes one by one

units.source: The selected notes will be indicated via a different background color and an icon.
units.context: Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection > Selecting notes one by one
Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection > Selecting notes in a sequence

units.source: When notes are in a sequence (e.g. one underneath the other), the entire selection can be made just by selecting the first and the last item instead of individually clicking all the notes.
units.context: Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection > Selecting notes in a sequence

units.source: To do so, first select the note to start the selection with. Then hold __TRILIUM_PH_0__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and click on the note to end the selection with. All the notes between the start and the end note will be selected as well.
units.context: Multiple selection > Types of multiple selection > Selecting notes in a sequence
Multiple selection > Selected notes vs. active note

units.source: There is a distinction between __TRILIUM_PH_0__selected notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and the __TRILIUM_PH_2__active note__TRILIUM_PH_3__:
units.context: Multiple selection > Selected notes vs. active note

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Selected notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are simply the notes that were selected in the multiple section process (i.e. either via __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or __TRILIUM_PH_4__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_5__).
units.context: Multiple selection > Selected notes vs. active note

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__active note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is simply the note that whose content is being displayed to the right of the tree.
units.context: Multiple selection > Selected notes vs. active note

units.source: Visually, it's identified in the tree by having a different background color and a subtle shadow.
units.context: Multiple selection > Selected notes vs. active note

units.source: The active note can also be selected case in which the icon and background will also change:
